crc_api.h

Software CRC calculation over a memory buffer and size-and-checksum validation for an image descriptor. The channel value is used as an input to the CRC calculation; callers must use the same value when validating.

crc_image_desc_t

Image description and expected values used by crc_api_validate().

Fields
image

Image bytes to validate. May be NULL only when actual_size is zero.

actual_size

Number of bytes present in image.

expected_size

Required image size used for the size check.

max_size

Optional upper size limit; zero disables this limit.

channel

Value passed to the CRC calculation context; its meaning is defined by the CRC driver.

expected_crc

CRC value that the calculated checksum must match.

crc_image_result_t

Validation result filled by crc_api_validate(). The structure is cleared on entry, and fields written before a failed check remain available to the caller.

Fields
calculated_crc

CRC calculated from the image when CRC calculation is reached.

actual_size

Copy of crc_image_desc_t.actual_size.

expected_size

Copy of crc_image_desc_t.expected_size.

size_valid

Nonzero only when the actual and expected sizes match and the optional maximum-size check passes.

crc_valid

Nonzero only when calculated_crc equals the expected CRC.

crc_api_calculate
int crc_api_calculate(
const 
uint8_t 
*
image,
size_t 
image_size,
uint64_t 
channel,
uint32_t 
*
crc_out
)

Compute the software CRC over image[0 .. image_size).

A NULL image is accepted only when image_size is 0. The stored value is then the CRC of an empty buffer.

Parameters
image
const uint8_t*

Bytes to checksum. NULL only when image_size is 0.

image_size
size_t

Number of bytes.

channel
uint64_t

Value passed to the CRC context. Meaning is defined by the CRC driver.

crc_out
uint32_t*

Receives the CRC. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -EINVAL when crc_out is NULL, or when image is NULL and image_size is not 0.

crc_api_validate
int crc_api_validate(
const 
crc_image_desc_t 
*
desc,
crc_image_result_t 
*
result
)

Check actual_size against expected_size and max_size, then compare the CRC with expected_crc.

On entry, result is cleared. actual_size and expected_size are copied before the checks. size_valid is set only when the sizes match. If the CRC is computed, calculated_crc is stored even when it does not match. crc_valid is set only when the CRC matches.

Parameters
desc
const crc_image_desc_t*

Image descriptor. Must be non-NULL.

result
crc_image_result_t*

Receives the check outcome. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 when the size and CRC both match. -EINVAL for a NULL pointer, or a NULL image with a non-zero actual_size. -EFBIG when max_size is non-zero and actual_size exceeds it. -EMSGSIZE when actual_size does not equal expected_size. -EIO when the CRC does not match.
